question: As we know from the graduation of micrometer, if we give one full round to thimble, its spindle moves 1½ mm forward or backward. A buck part can be divided into 0 to 50 parts. The least count of the micrometer is mm.
solution:
The correct answer is __0.01__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The least count of a micrometer is defined as the smallest measurement that can be accurately measured using the instrument.
 
• In a micrometer, a full rotation of the thimble moves the spindle by 0.5 mm.
 
• The thimble scale is divided into 50 equal parts.
 
• The least count of the micrometer is calculated as:

 **Least Count = (Pitch of screw) / (Number of divisions on the thimble scale)**
 
• For this micrometer:

 **Least Count = 0.5 mm / 50 = 0.01 mm.**
 
• Thus, the least count of the micrometer is **0.01 mm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Micrometer:**

 
 
• A micrometer is a precision measuring instrument used to measure small dimensions.
 
• It provides greater accuracy than a vernier caliper.
 
• It is commonly used in mechanical engineering and machining applications.
 
 
 
• **Pitch:**
 
 
• Pitch refers to the distance moved by the spindle per full rotation of the thimble.
 
• For a standard micrometer, the pitch is usually 0.5 mm.
